_about: Vertical shorts for the manual SNS post queue (Ebi AI Console). Platform ids match ebibibi-claude-settings promote-all/post_targets.json. Values checked 2026-11-22; sources below. safe = px kept free of text/face at 1080x1920 (top/bottom/left/right). Attachments to the post queue are limited to 200 MB.

tiktok.notes: Sound-on culture; captions are added by creators themselves. Safe zone from TikTok's ad templates (no official number).

instagram.notes: Over 3 min is not recommended to non-followers. Tutorials do best at 15-60 s. Meta asks to keep text out of the top 14 %, bottom 35 %, sides 6 %. Watermarks of other apps are penalised.

facebook.notes: 90 s is the Reels API limit (the app lifted limits in 2025); keep it at 90 s. Post text without the YouTube URL.

threads.notes: Text-first; post text max 500 chars carries the point, the video supports it.

x.notes: Free accounts: 140 s and 512 MB. Post text: 140 full-width characters.

forbidden_in_posts: プロフィールのリンク
